events.outcome: Current Three first-party pages no longer allow a new PAYG voice SIM to be ordered free on its own: a new SIM must be paired with a Data Pack, with the lowest currently displayed one-month Data Pack at £10. Standard PAYG rates remain 35p/min, 15p/text and 10p/MB. The number remains active only with at least one qualifying chargeable activity every 180 days; Wi-Fi-only activity does not count, and a disconnected number cannot be restored.
Three currently supports PAYG eSIM as well as physical SIM. Existing PAYG customers can request a replacement eSIM through My3 or the Three app, and new PAYG Data Pack offers can be selected as eSIM.

Before PAYG can be used abroad, Three requires the SIM/device to connect to the Three network in the UK and, if no allowance is preloaded, to top up or add a Data Pack in the UK. Three states receiving texts while roaming is free across the published PAYG destination bands, but destination/network availability is not treated as guaranteed.

data.acquisitionSummary: Current Three PAYG support requires at least one chargeable activity every 180 days. Buying a top-up/Data Pack/Add-on counts; calls, texts and data count only on Three mobile service, not Wi-Fi. Current standard SMS is 15p and current PAYG price guidance includes a £5 top-up. A PAYG SIM intended for use abroad must first be provisioned by a UK purchase/activation step.

keep.action: Before 180 days elapse, perform one qualifying chargeable activity. A standard UK SMS is currently £0.15; buying a top-up also resets the clock. Wi-Fi-only activity does not count. Once disconnected, the number cannot be reconnected.

data.chinaActivation: Three requires a purchase associated with the SIM in the UK before using Three services abroad; PAYG eSIM is currently offered.
data.payment: Three app/My3/web top-up by card; current top-up denominations include GBP5. International-card acceptance not independently reconciled.
data.wifiCalling: unverified for the keep-alive event; Wi-Fi activity does not satisfy the 180-day rule.
data.roamingSms: Receiving SMS abroad free (UK operator standard). Sending from China requires roaming — Three roaming add-on structure applies; receiving-only strategy viable.
data.tariffSummary: 180-day chargeable-activity rule; 15p standard SMS; top-up credit available from £5; disconnected number cannot be restored.
guideSteps: Order the Three PAYG SIM/eSIM. If you plan to use it abroad, complete the required UK purchase/provisioning step first.
Keep some PAYG credit, then before 180 days elapse send one standard SMS on the mobile network (currently 15p), or perform another listed chargeable activity.
Do not rely on Wi-Fi-only activity; Three says it does not count, and a disconnected number cannot be restored.

data.kyc: No universal PAYG identity-document requirement established in the reviewed Three sources.

data.wifiCalling: Do not use Wi-Fi-only activity as the keep-alive event; Three explicitly says it does not satisfy the 180-day chargeable-activity rule.
data.roamingSms: Three states receiving texts while roaming is free in its published PAYG destination bands. UK-first provisioning is required before travel; actual roaming reachability remains destination and partner-network dependent.
data.tariffSummary: New PAYG SIM requires a Data Pack; lowest currently displayed one-month pack £10. Standard PAYG: 35p/min, 15p/text, 10p/MB. One qualifying chargeable activity every 180 days keeps the number active; disconnection is irreversible.
guideSteps: Buy a Three PAYG physical SIM or eSIM with a Data Pack; a new SIM can no longer be ordered free by itself.
Before relying on it abroad, connect it to the Three network in the UK and complete any required UK top-up/Data Pack provisioning.
Before each 180-day inactivity deadline, make a qualifying chargeable mobile-network action; a standard UK SMS currently costs 15p.
Do not rely on Wi-Fi-only use to reset the timer. If Three disconnects the PAYG number for inactivity, it cannot be reconnected.
Treat incoming roaming SMS as officially free, but verify destination/partner-network reachability before depending on the number for critical recovery.
